name: Status Bar (Android style)
description: Android-style status icons in the top bar: each icon takes the width of its ink instead of a square frame, the volume indicator only shows when the output is muted, and the battery is drawn as a pill with the percentage inside. Colours and the pill height come from the m3e-gnome Shell theme stylesheet. Reaches into private fields of the Shell quick settings (verified on GNOME Shell 50.5 only).
